AI.theory_contributions: 为合同法与数据保护法的交叉研究提供理论框架，拓展数字资产法律保护的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律从业者和数字资产行业提供实践指导，促进欧洲合同法在数字资产领域的有效适用。

title: A Dynamical Systems Architecture for Reasoning Stability and Abrupt Mode Switching in AI and Human Cognition

detail.title: A Dynamical Systems Architecture for Reasoning Stability and Abrupt Mode Switching in AI and Human Cognition
detail.abstract: This working paper introduces a unified dynamical-systems architecture that explains abrupt transitions in reasoning stability, including evaluative collapse, delayed recovery, and reorganizing trajectories observed in both artificial and human cognition. The model formalizes how evaluative load, independence-state drift, and structured entropy interact through a mathematical invariant whose switching thresholds generate discrete changes in reasoning mode. By specifying an invariant, drift measure, and hysteresis thresholds, the framework distinguishes stable reasoning, ambiguity drift, and collapse basins, and it provides a way to forecast transitions before they occur. A worked numerical example illustrates how small changes in the system's parameters can trigger regime shifts, and how recovery follows a different threshold than collapse. The architecture is directly implementable in artificial reasoning systems and offers a structural template for empirical work on human cognition and organizational decision processes under pressure. It is intended as a platform for testing stability control in AI inference, for modeling evaluative narrowing and recovery in human reasoning, and for analyzing collapse and reorganization dynamics in institutional settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的动力学系统架构，解释推理稳定性中的突然转变，包括评估崩溃、延迟恢复和重组轨迹等现象。该模型通过数学不变量形式化评估负荷、独立性状态漂移和结构化熵的相互作用，其切换阈值产生推理模式的离散变化。
AI.research_question: 如何用统一的动力学系统架构解释和预测推理稳定性中的突然转变，包括评估崩溃、延迟恢复和重组轨迹？
AI.motivation: 在人工智能和人类认知中观察到推理稳定性的突然转变现象（如评估崩溃、延迟恢复），需要统一的框架来解释这些动力学行为并预测转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动力学系统理论，特别是基于不变量、漂移度量和滞后阈值的架构，区分稳定推理、模糊漂移和崩溃盆地。
AI.method: 提出数学建模框架，通过指定不变量、漂移度量和滞后阈值，构建动力学系统模型，并通过数值示例演示参数变化如何触发状态转变。
AI.findings: 小参数变化可触发状态转变，恢复阈值不同于崩溃阈值；框架能预测转变发生，区分不同推理模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供统一的动力学系统架构解释推理稳定性转变；形式化评估负荷、独立性状态漂移和结构化熵的相互作用；提出预测转变的数学框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 可直接在人工智能推理系统中实现；为人类认知和组织决策过程的实证研究提供结构模板；可用于测试AI推理稳定性控制、建模人类推理中的评估窄化和恢复、分析制度环境中的崩溃和重组动态。

title: How to Use the Sharpe Ratio (Seminar Slides)
affiliations: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Cornell University - Operations Research & Industrial Engineering

detail.title: How to Use the Sharpe Ratio (Seminar Slides)
detail.abstract:
•One of the most widely accepted measures of investment efficiency is the Sharpe ratio, which expresses excess return relative to volatility
•While the Sharpe ratio is reported ubiquitously in academic and practitioner publications, the inference done on it is often wrong
•Common mistakes include:
–Comparing annualized Sharpe ratios, without taking into account its sampling variance
–Using generic statistical tests that make unrealistic assumptions, such as i.i.d. Normal returns
–Neglect minimum sample lengths and the power of the test
–Interpreting the rejection of the null hypothesis as evidence that the null hypothesis is likely false
–Ignoring multiple testing corrections
•In this seminar, we review how to use the Sharpe ratio for making investment decisions within a sound statistical framework

AI.tldr: 本文指出夏普比率作为投资效率衡量指标被广泛使用，但在统计推断中存在常见错误，包括忽略抽样方差、使用不现实的假设、忽视样本量和检验功效、误解假设检验结果、忽略多重检验校正等，并提出了在稳健统计框架下使用夏普比率进行投资决策的方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在稳健的统计框架下正确使用夏普比率进行投资决策？
AI.motivation: 夏普比率作为衡量投资效率的指标在学术界和实务界被广泛使用，但对其进行的统计推断经常存在错误，导致投资决策可能基于不准确的统计结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资绩效评估理论、统计推断理论、假设检验理论、时间序列分析理论
AI.method: 文献综述与批判性分析，识别夏普比率使用中的常见统计错误，并提出改进的统计框架
AI.findings: 发现夏普比率使用中存在五大常见错误：1)比较年化夏普比率时忽略抽样方差；2)使用基于不现实假设（如i.i.d.正态收益）的通用统计检验；3)忽视最小样本长度和检验功效；4)将拒绝原假设解释为原假设很可能为假；5)忽略多重检验校正。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了夏普比率统计推断中的理论误区，为投资绩效评估提供了更严谨的统计理论基础，强调了在投资决策中考虑统计不确定性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资从业者提供了正确使用夏普比率的实用指南，帮助避免常见的统计陷阱，提高投资决策的科学性和可靠性。

title: Measuring Global Supply Chain Disruptions: A Systematic Review of Existing Indexes and Indicators
affiliations: Global Supply Chain and Independent author

detail.title: Measuring Global Supply Chain Disruptions: A Systematic Review of Existing Indexes and Indicators
detail.abstract: Global supply chains have experienced repeated disruptions driven by geopolitical tensions, pandemics, natural disasters, transportation bottlenecks, and labor shortages. Numerous indicators and indexes attempt to measure these disruptions, including freight rates, delivery-time metrics, trade-flow indicators, commodity market signals, and event-driven risk measures. However, these tools were developed independently, rely on heterogeneous data sources, and capture only partial aspects of disruption, resulting in a fragmented measurement landscape. This paper presents a systematic review of major indicators and indexes used to quantify global supply chain disruptions. Using a structured multi-phase search strategy, it analyzes peer-reviewed studies, institutional reports, and industry metrics across six domains: transportation and logistics, production and suppliers, trade flows, labor markets, commodity and energy markets, and geopolitical or policy shocks. For each measure, the review summarizes its purpose, data foundation, methodology, strengths, and limitations. The findings show that existing indicators provide useful but siloed insights and do not capture disruptions across all domains in an integrated way. Addressing this gap is essential for improving forecasting, risk management, and resilience planning. The review synthesizes fragmented measurement approaches and proposes the Global Supply Chain Disruption Index (GSCDI) framework as a unified conceptual foundation for future empirical development.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了全球供应链中断的主要测量指标和指数，发现现有工具各自为政、数据源异质且只能捕捉部分中断特征，提出了统一的全球供应链中断指数（GSCDI）框架作为未来实证发展的概念基础。
AI.research_question: 如何系统评估和整合当前用于量化全球供应链中断的各种指标和指数？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链面临地缘政治紧张、疫情、自然灾害、运输瓶颈和劳动力短缺等多重中断，现有测量工具各自独立开发、数据源异质且只能捕捉部分中断特征，导致测量体系碎片化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链中断测量理论、风险评估框架、指标整合理论
AI.method: 采用结构化多阶段搜索策略，分析六个领域的同行评审研究、机构报告和行业指标：运输与物流、生产与供应商、贸易流、劳动力市场、商品与能源市场、地缘政治或政策冲击。
AI.findings: 现有指标提供了有用但孤立的见解，无法以集成方式捕捉所有领域的中断；测量方法碎片化，缺乏统一框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了全球供应链中断指数（GSCDI）框架作为统一的概念基础，为未来实证发展提供理论指导；系统整合了碎片化的测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进预测、风险管理和韧性规划提供基础；帮助政策制定者和企业管理者更全面评估供应链风险；促进跨领域指标整合。

title: Reassessing Accounting Anomalies in an Investable U.S. Equity Universe
affiliations: , University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne), University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne) and University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne)

detail.title: Reassessing Accounting Anomalies in an Investable U.S. Equity Universe
detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the profitability of 25 accounting-based signals in the U.S. equity market over the period 1963-2024. Using CRSP returns, Compustat annual fundamentals, and the CRSP-Compustat Merged database, we construct a point-in-time panel of U.S. common stocks and implement conservative filters (NYSE P20 size breakpoint, minimum price of $5, and historical return requirements) to approximate a liquid, investable universe. We form value-weighted and equal-weighted long-short decile portfolios, correct for delisting bias, and evaluate performance using Fama-French six-factor regressions with Newey-West standard errors and an explicit |t| > 3 benchmark to account for multiple testing. Our results show that, once we focus on value-weighted portfolios in this liquid universe, most fundamental signals fail to deliver statistically significant alphas and appear largely absorbed by modern risk factors. A small subset of strategies remains economically meaningful. A "Cash Cushion" measure of financial flexibility yields an annualised six-factor alpha of roughly 5%, gross of transaction costs, with t ≈ 2.1 in the full sample, and somewhat larger point estimates in the post-1980 and post-2000 subperiods; we interpret this as a promising, but not definitive, candidate for a defensive premium. By contrast, several growth and quality-related signals-most notably ROIC Momentum and Intangible Power-earn large and robustly negative alphas with |t| > 3, suggesting that the market tends to overpay for certain improvement and intangible-capital stories. We highlight that our deeper analysis of Cash Cushion and ROIC Momentum is conducted ex post, based on their full-sample performance. Overall, the evidence points to limited scope for robust, value-weighted alpha from standard accounting signals in U.S. equities, with the most compelling opportunities arising on the short side rather than from long-only fundamental tilts.

AI.tldr: 该研究重新检验了1963-2024年间美国股市25个会计基础信号的盈利能力。研究发现，在流动性投资组合中，大多数基本面信号无法产生显著超额收益，只有少数策略（如"现金缓冲"）保持经济意义，而增长和质量相关信号则产生显著负alpha。
AI.research_question: 在美国股市中，25个会计基础信号在流动性投资组合中是否仍能产生显著的超额收益？
AI.motivation: 重新检验传统会计基础信号的盈利能力，特别是在现代风险因子框架下，这些信号是否仍能提供稳健的alpha，以及哪些信号在流动性投资环境中仍然有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效市场假说和现代资产定价理论，特别是Fama-French六因子模型，检验会计信号是否被风险因子充分解释。
AI.method: 使用CRSP、Compustat和CRSP-Compustat Merged数据库构建1963-2024年面板数据，采用保守筛选标准（NYSE P20规模分界点、最低股价5美元、历史回报要求）构建流动性投资组合，形成价值加权和等权重多空十分位组合，使用Fama-French六因子回归和Newey-West标准误，采用|t|>3的多重检验基准。
AI.findings: 在流动性投资组合中，大多数基本面信号无法产生统计显著的超额收益，只有少数策略保持经济意义。"现金缓冲"策略产生约5%的年化六因子alpha（t≈2.1），而ROIC动量和无形资产力量等增长/质量信号产生显著负alpha（|t|>3），表明市场对这些改善和无形资产故事过度支付。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 在流动性投资环境中重新评估会计信号的定价能力；2) 识别"现金缓冲"作为潜在防御性溢价候选；3) 发现增长和质量相关信号的负alpha现象，支持市场过度反应理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供流动性投资组合中会计信号有效性的实证证据；2) 识别"现金缓冲"作为潜在防御性策略；3) 建议关注空头机会而非多头基本面倾斜；4) 提供多重检验校正的严谨分析方法。

title: Asset Allocation with a Carbon Objective
affiliations: , University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne), University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne), University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne) and University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne)

detail.title: Asset Allocation with a Carbon Objective
detail.abstract: Can deep portfolio decarbonisation be achieved without eroding financial performance? Using monthly returns and annual CO 2 data for more than 600 North-American equities (2014-2024), we extend mean-variance optimisation into a three-dimensional (u, o, carbon) space and evaluate five allocations: (i) an unconstrained minimum-variance portfolio; (ii) a value-weighted benchmark; (iii) a minimum-variance design capped at 50 % of its own footprint; (iv) a benchmark-neutral strategy that halves the benchmark footprint subject to a tracking-error budget; and (v) a dynamic Net-Zero portfolio imposing a 10 % yearly emissions decline. Across the sample, carbon-constrained strategies cut financed emissions by 20-50 % while delivering Sharpe ratios statistically indistinguishable from-sometimes superior to-the unconstrained benchmark. Their annualised tracking errors cluster around 4.9 %, well above the 0.30-0.50 % floor to prevent index replication. Only the Net-Zero design at the shortest look-back window (48 months) briefly peaks at 7.4 % before reverting below 5 % as the estimation horizon lengthens. Early cuts of up to roughly 50 % in carbon footprint appear to entail little to no performance penalty, whereas deeper reductions trade off transparently against the tracking-error "budget". The Net-Zero trajectory remains consistent with a 1.5 • C carbon budget while preserving almost the entire equity risk premium, offering counter-evidence to the notion of an inevitable sustainability tax. Overall, the evidence shows that ambitious, Paris-aligned decarbonisation can be embedded in mainstream portfolios through explicit tracking-error limits, offering investors a coherent and auditable framework for aligning assets with the Paris Agreement while maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，通过将均值-方差优化扩展到三维空间（收益、风险、碳），可以在不显著牺牲财务绩效的情况下实现深度投资组合脱碳。基于北美600多只股票数据（2014-2024年），碳约束策略能减少20-50%的融资排放，同时夏普比率与无约束基准无统计差异甚至更优，年化跟踪误差约4.9%。净零排放组合与1.5°C碳预算一致，几乎保留了全部股权风险溢价。
AI.research_question: 深度投资组合脱碳能否在不侵蚀财务绩效的情况下实现？
AI.motivation: 随着投资者对气候风险和《巴黎协定》合规性的关注增加，需要实证证据来评估碳约束投资策略的财务影响，挑战"可持续性税"的观念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将经典均值-方差投资组合理论扩展到三维空间（收益μ、风险σ、碳排放），建立碳约束下的投资组合优化框架。
AI.method: 使用北美600多只股票的月度收益和年度CO₂数据（2014-2024年），评估五种投资组合配置：无约束最小方差组合、市值加权基准、碳足迹限制在50%的最小方差组合、基准中性策略（碳足迹减半+跟踪误差预算）、动态净零组合（年排放下降10%）。
AI.findings: 碳约束策略能减少20-50%的融资排放，夏普比率与无约束基准无统计差异甚至更优。年化跟踪误差约4.9%，远高于防止指数复制的0.30-0.50%下限。净零组合在最短回溯窗口（48个月）时短暂达到7.4%，但随着估计期延长回落至5%以下。早期碳足迹减少约50%几乎无绩效损失，更深减排与跟踪误差预算存在权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统投资组合理论扩展到三维碳约束空间，为碳约束投资组合优化提供理论框架，挑战"可持续性税"的传统观念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供通过明确跟踪误差限制将《巴黎协定》合规性嵌入主流投资组合的可行框架，证明雄心勃勃的脱碳目标可以与竞争性财务绩效共存。

title: The Epistemic Sabotage; Misinformation and the Erosion of Democratic Power

detail.title: The Epistemic Sabotage; Misinformation and the Erosion of Democratic Power
detail.abstract: This paper explores how misinformation acts as a structural force undermining the epistemic conditions necessary for democratic legitimacy. Drawing on Robert Dahl's criteria of effective participation and enlightened understanding, along with classical liberal conceptions of consent, the paper argues that democracy cannot meaningfully function when citizens form political preferences under distorted or asymmetrically curated information conditions. Using the United States as the central case, the paper examines how state narratives, media ecosystems, and algorithmic infrastructures converge to shape public perception on issues ranging from foreign policy to national security, to racialised conflict. Instead of treating misinformation as an incidental by-product of digital media, the analysis here frames it as a systemic feature of contemporary governance-that is, one wherein existing power hierarchies are iteratively secured amidst an outward appearance of pluralism and free choice. The paper concludes that misinformation engenders a self-reinforcing feedback loop wherein the misinformed citizenry unwittingly stabilises the very institutions limiting their autonomy, leaving the democratic order procedurally intact but substantively weakened.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了错误信息如何作为一种结构性力量，破坏民主合法性所需的认知条件。基于罗伯特·达尔的民主标准和古典自由主义同意理论，论文认为当公民在扭曲或不对称的信息环境中形成政治偏好时，民主无法有效运作。以美国为中心案例，分析了国家叙事、媒体生态系统和算法基础设施如何共同塑造公众对从外交政策到国家安全再到种族冲突等议题的认知。论文将错误信息视为当代治理的系统性特征而非数字媒体的偶然副产品，指出其通过表面多元化和自由选择的外表，迭代性地巩固现有权力等级。结论认为错误信息产生自我强化的反馈循环，使被误导的公民无意中稳定了限制其自主权的制度，导致民主秩序在程序上完整但实质上被削弱。
AI.research_question: 错误信息如何作为结构性力量破坏民主合法性所需的认知条件？
AI.motivation: 随着数字媒体时代的到来，错误信息问题日益严重，威胁到民主制度的运作基础。传统上错误信息被视为技术或媒体问题，但本文认为需要从结构性角度理解其对民主合法性的根本性威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 罗伯特·达尔的民主理论（有效参与和开明理解标准）
2. 古典自由主义的同意理论
3. 结构性权力理论
4. 系统治理理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以美国为中心案例，分析国家叙事、媒体生态系统和算法基础设施如何共同塑造公众认知。采用理论分析和系统分析相结合的方法。
AI.findings:
1. 错误信息不是数字媒体的偶然副产品，而是当代治理的系统性特征
2. 国家叙事、媒体生态系统和算法基础设施共同塑造扭曲的信息环境
3. 错误信息通过表面多元化和自由选择的外表，迭代性地巩固现有权力等级
4. 错误信息产生自我强化的反馈循环，使被误导的公民无意中稳定了限制其自主权的制度
5. 民主秩序在程序上保持完整但实质上被削弱
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将错误信息概念化为结构性力量而非技术问题
2. 将达尔的民主理论与错误信息分析相结合
3. 提出"系统性治理特征"的理论框架
4. 发展了错误信息与民主合法性关系的理论模型
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了理解错误信息结构性影响的框架
2. 指出了媒体监管和算法治理的重要性
3. 强调了民主教育在对抗错误信息中的作用
4. 为公民社会组织和民主倡导者提供了分析工具

title: The Macroeconomic Effect of Fiscal Announcements: News-Based Evidence from European Countries

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Effect of Fiscal Announcements: News-Based Evidence from European Countries

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, clinical data, or identifiable personal information. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Department of Foundations of Economic Analysis at the University of Alicante.

detail.abstract: Fiscal policy is usually announced before it is implemented, and such announcements can affect macroeconomic conditions regardless of whether the announced measures are actually implemented. In this paper, I construct two new quarterly fiscal announcement indices-one specific to public spending and the other to taxation-based on press reports from four major euro area economies: Spain, France, Italy, and Germany (1999-2025). Using large language models, whose classifications I validate manually, I systematically code each news item according to the fiscal stance it conveys, the responsible institutional level and the type of communication. I then incorporate these specific government expenditure and taxation indices into a battery of bayesian vector autoregressive models, estimated both by country and in a grouped panel framework, with recursive identification. I demonstrate that, consistently across the four countries-although the responses for Germany are somewhat less stable-signals of increased public spending anticipate actual increases in government expenditure and generate clear and persistent expansions in GDP and consumption, while announcements of tax increases boost tax revenues but produce more moderate and shorter-lived contractions. Overall, the results confirm that press reports contain useful information for identifying the shocks caused by fiscal announcements.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了欧元区四国（西班牙、法国、意大利、德国）的财政公告指数，使用大语言模型分析新闻报道，发现公共支出增加信号会预测实际支出增长并带来GDP和消费扩张，而增税公告会提高税收但产生温和短暂的经济收缩。
AI.research_question: 财政政策公告（特别是公共支出和税收方面的公告）如何影响宏观经济条件？新闻报道中的财政政策信号是否包含识别财政公告冲击的有用信息？
AI.motivation: 财政政策通常在实施前宣布，这些公告无论最终是否实施都可能影响宏观经济。现有研究对财政公告的宏观经济效应关注不足，特别是基于新闻报道的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政政策传导机制理论，特别是预期渠道理论。财政公告通过影响市场预期和私人部门行为来影响经济活动，即使政策尚未实施。
AI.method: 1. 构建两个新的季度财政公告指数（公共支出和税收），基于西班牙、法国、意大利、德国四国新闻报道（1999-2025）；2. 使用大语言模型对新闻项目进行分类（财政立场、责任机构层级、沟通类型），并进行人工验证；3. 将指数纳入贝叶斯向量自回归模型，分别进行国别估计和面板分组框架估计，采用递归识别方法。
AI.findings: 1. 公共支出增加信号能预测实际政府支出增长，并产生明显且持久的GDP和消费扩张；2. 增税公告能提高税收收入，但产生更温和、更短期的经济收缩；3. 德国结果相对不太稳定；4. 新闻报道包含识别财政公告冲击的有用信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为财政政策预期渠道提供了实证支持；2. 开发了基于新闻报道的财政公告指数构建方法；3. 验证了财政公告独立于实际政策实施的经济效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了财政沟通策略的实证依据；2. 为市场参与者提供了预测财政政策影响的工具；3. 为研究人员提供了分析财政公告效应的新方法框架。

title: Predictive Modeling for Drone Swarm Attack Defense: AI Trajectory Forecasting and Optimal Intercept Strategy Design for U.S. Military Readiness
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands

detail.title: Predictive Modeling for Drone Swarm Attack Defense: AI Trajectory Forecasting and Optimal Intercept Strategy Design for U.S. Military Readiness
detail.abstract: This research investigates the application of advanced machine learning techniquesincluding Reinforcement Learning (RL), Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and multi-agent simulation-to predict drone swarm trajectories and optimize defensive intercept strategies. Drone swarms represent one of the most rapidly advancing and strategically significant threats to U.S. airbases, naval fleets, and forward-operating installations. By modeling swarm maneuvers validated against real-world demonstrations from China, the United States, Russia, and Iran, this study demonstrates that predictive AI systems can reliably forecast swarm behavior and significantly improve intercept success rates. The research introduces an integrated architecture that combines multi-sensor fusion, decentralized swarm prediction, reinforcement-learning decision engines, and layered defensive strategies involving electronic warfare, directed-energy weapons, and kinetic interceptors. Results show that RL-based models outperform traditional LSTM and GNN approaches in forecasting emergent swarm behaviors and identifying optimal defensive responses under resource and time constraints. This work provides a technically rigorous and operationally relevant foundation for AIenabled counter-swarm systems, aligning with multiple Department of Defense modernization initiatives, including Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2), autonomous systems integration, and counter-UAS resilience.

AI.tldr: 该研究应用强化学习、图神经网络和多智能体仿真技术预测无人机集群轨迹并优化防御拦截策略，结果显示强化学习方法在预测集群涌现行为和优化防御响应方面优于传统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何应用先进机器学习技术（特别是强化学习、图神经网络和多智能体仿真）来预测无人机集群轨迹并优化防御拦截策略？
AI.motivation: 无人机集群是美国空军基地、海军舰队和前沿作战设施面临的最快速发展和最具战略意义的威胁之一，需要开发有效的反集群系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化学习理论、图神经网络理论、多智能体系统理论、传感器融合理论、电子战理论、定向能武器理论。
AI.method: 集成架构结合多传感器融合、去中心化集群预测、强化学习决策引擎，以及包含电子战、定向能武器和动能拦截器的分层防御策略；使用真实世界演示数据进行模型验证。
AI.findings: 基于强化学习的模型在预测集群涌现行为和识别资源与时间约束下的最优防御响应方面，优于传统的LSTM和GNN方法；预测AI系统能够可靠预测集群行为并显著提高拦截成功率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI赋能的对抗集群系统提供了技术严谨且操作相关的基础框架；推进了强化学习在复杂多智能体系统预测和决策中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持美国国防部现代化倡议，包括联合全域指挥与控制、自主系统集成和反无人机系统韧性；为军事防御系统提供了可操作的技术解决方案。

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Peer-Level Consultant in Surgery: Automation Bias, Human Judgment, and Legal Accountability

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Peer-Level Consultant in Surgery: Automation Bias, Human Judgment, and Legal Accountability

keywords: Artificial Intelligence; Healthcare AI; Automation Bias; Medical Liability; Health Law; Human Judgment; Clinical Decision Support; AI Governance; EU AI Act; FDA Regulation

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed as decision support tools in high-risk clinical environments, yet their influence on expert judgment and their implications for legal accountability remain poorly understood. This paper examines how artificial intelligence alters professional decision-making and how that alteration challenges existing doctrines of medical liability and standard of care. Using a controlled comparative design, a senior subspecialist surgeon and a multimodal large language model were evaluated on high-complexity board-level surgical questions. Although both achieved identical overall accuracy, qualitative divergence analysis revealed distinct cognitive roles. The artificial intelligence system demonstrated superior semantic precision and strict adherence to textual decision rules, while the human expert outperformed in visual interpretation and clinical safety judgment. Critically, the study documents a clear instance of automation bias in which the human expert deferred to a confident but incorrect artificial intelligence output, resulting in an automation-induced deference error. These findings have direct legal significance. They demonstrate how artificial intelligence can function as a persuasive cognitive actor that reshapes professional judgment without bearing legal responsibility for outcomes. The analysis situates this phenomenon within contemporary frameworks of medical malpractice, product liability, and the erosion of the learned intermediary doctrine, as well as emerging regulatory approaches in the United States and the European Union. The paper proposes a Parallel Review model in which artificial intelligence serves as a precision check rather than a decision authority, preserving human accountability while mitigating automation bias.

AI.tldr: 研究通过对比外科专家与AI在复杂手术问题上的表现，发现两者准确率相同但认知方式不同：AI在语义精确性和规则遵循上更优，而人类在视觉解读和临床安全判断上更强。研究发现存在自动化偏见，即人类专家会顺从自信但错误的AI输出，导致自动化诱导的顺从错误。这对医疗责任认定有重要法律意义。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何改变专业决策过程，以及这种改变如何挑战现有的医疗责任和护理标准原则？
AI.motivation: 人工智能系统越来越多地作为高风险临床环境中的决策支持工具部署，但其对专家判断的影响及其对法律责任的启示仍知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗事故责任、产品责任、学习中介原则的侵蚀，以及美国和欧盟的新兴监管方法。
AI.method: 采用对照比较设计，评估一位高级专科外科医生和一个多模态大语言模型在高度复杂性手术问题上的表现。
AI.findings: 虽然两者总体准确率相同，但定性差异分析显示不同的认知角色：AI系统在语义精确性和严格遵循文本决策规则方面表现更优，而人类专家在视觉解读和临床安全判断方面更胜一筹。研究记录了自动化偏见的明确实例，即人类专家顺从了自信但错误的AI输出，导致自动化诱导的顺从错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了AI如何作为有说服力的认知参与者，在不承担结果法律责任的情况下重塑专业判断。将这一现象置于当代医疗事故、产品责任和学习中介原则侵蚀的框架中分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"平行审查"模型，其中AI作为精确性检查而非决策权威，在减轻自动化偏见的同时保留人类责任。

reference: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1174; https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1174
title: How Do Banks Build Equity Capital?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: How Do Banks Build Equity Capital?

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1174
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the evolution of equity capital in the U.S. banking industry over the past 35 years. Earnings are the major driver of increases in equity capital in the banking industry. While common stock issuance is frequent, amounts issued are generally small and do not contribute meaningfully to equity capital growth in most cases. Common stock dividends and repurchases are significant drains on equity capital. It is not uncommon for banks to pay out more than they earn, driven both by capital planning motivations and negative shocks to earnings. It is also common for banks to both issue new common stock and make repurchases in the same year, with these offsetting actions related to employee stock-based compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国银行业过去35年股权资本的演变，发现收益是股权资本增长的主要驱动力，股票发行频繁但金额较小，而股息和回购则是股权资本的重要消耗因素。
AI.research_question: 美国银行业股权资本在过去35年间如何演变？收益、股票发行、股息和回购各自对股权资本变化有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解银行业股权资本的动态变化对于监管政策制定、银行风险管理以及投资者决策具有重要意义，但现有研究对银行业股权资本演变机制的系统分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本结构理论、银行资本监管框架和公司财务决策理论，分析银行业股权资本变化的驱动因素。
AI.method: 使用美国银行业35年的面板数据，通过统计分析检验收益、股票发行、股息和回购对股权资本变化的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 收益是股权资本增长的主要驱动力；2. 普通股发行频繁但金额较小，对股权资本增长贡献有限；3. 股息和回购是股权资本的重要消耗；4. 许多银行支付超过收益，既有资本规划动机也有收益负冲击影响；5. 银行经常在同一年发行新股和进行回购，这些抵消性行为与员工股票薪酬相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对银行业股权资本动态变化机制的理解，揭示了收益、融资和分配决策之间的复杂互动关系，为银行资本管理理论提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层提供资本规划参考，为监管机构制定资本充足率政策提供依据，帮助投资者更好地评估银行资本管理实践和风险状况。

reference: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management and Statistics Working Paper No. 565
title: The Risk Premia from the European Equity Market: An application of the Three-Pass Estimation Methodology
affiliations: Milano-Bicocca University and Milano-Bicocca University

detail.title: The Risk Premia from the European Equity Market: An application of the Three-Pass Estimation Methodology

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management and Statistics Working Paper No. 565
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management & Statistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop an empirical application on a large dataset of European stock returns, in order to estimate the risk premia. We propose an application of the Three-Pass Estimation Method (3PEM) by Xiu and Giglio (2021) as a multipurpose tool in asset pricing. By assuming the Fama-French Five-Factor model (Fama and French (2015)) as baseline model, we show that the 3PEM yields risk premium estimates that are more economically plausible and statistically robust than those obtained using the traditional two-pass estimation method (2PEM). Moreover, we extend the results by Xiu and Giglio (2021) showing that the 3PEM is able to detect noise in tradable factors. Furthermore, the method is used to denoise the observed factors, providing purified versions that better capture the systematic components of risk. We also identify noisy factors, and yield denoised factor series that improve the estimation of stock-level exposures and expected returns.

AI.tldr: 本文应用Xiu和Giglio(2021)提出的三阶段估计方法(3PEM)于欧洲股票收益大数据集，估计风险溢价。相比传统两阶段方法(2PEM)，3PEM得到更经济合理、统计稳健的风险溢价估计，并能检测交易因子中的噪声，提供去噪因子版本以更好捕捉系统性风险成分。
AI.research_question: 三阶段估计方法(3PEM)在欧洲股票市场中相比传统两阶段方法(2PEM)在风险溢价估计、噪声因子检测和因子去噪方面有何优势？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型中的两阶段估计方法可能存在估计偏差和统计问题，需要更稳健的方法来准确估计风险溢价并处理因子中的噪声成分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Fama-French五因子模型作为基准模型，应用Xiu和Giglio(2021)提出的三阶段估计方法理论框架。
AI.method: 使用欧洲股票收益大数据集，应用三阶段估计方法(3PEM)进行实证分析，并与传统两阶段方法(2PEM)进行比较。
AI.findings: 3PEM相比2PEM产生更经济合理、统计稳健的风险溢价估计；能够检测交易因子中的噪声；提供去噪因子版本改善系统性风险捕捉；去噪因子序列改进股票层面暴露和预期收益估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Xiu和Giglio(2021)的3PEM理论，证明其能检测噪声因子；为资产定价领域提供了多用途工具的理论验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲股票市场的风险溢价估计提供更可靠的实证方法；为投资者和从业者提供去噪因子工具以改进投资决策和风险管理。

title: Export Market Participation and Interest Rates: the Role of Organizational Capital
affiliations: LUISS "Guido Carli" University, , LUISS Guido Carli - Department of Economics, University of Molise and Roma Tre University

detail.title: Export Market Participation and Interest Rates: the Role of Organizational Capital

publicationDetails.detailsText: Centro Studi Luca d'Agliano Development Studies Working Paper No. 509
publicationDetails.journalName: Centro Studi Luca d'Agliano Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: How do interest rates influence firms' export decisions? We first develop a dynamic model of heterogeneous firms that highlights two key mechanisms: (i) a time lag between export costs and revenues, and (ii) the accumulation of organizational capital. Higher interest rates reduce both the extensive and intensive margins of exporting, the more so for firms with lower organizational capital. We then test these predictions using panel data on Portuguese firms (2008-2021). Our results show that organizational capital mitigates the adverse effect of higher interest rates, and this result is robust to alternative estimation strategies designed to address potential identification concerns. We also show that the magnitude of this mitigating effect depends on firm characteristics shaping access to external funding, i.e., leverage, asset tangibility, and profitability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了利率如何通过时间滞后和组织资本积累机制影响企业出口决策。研究发现，高利率会降低出口的广延边际和集约边际，而组织资本能够缓解这种负面影响，且缓解效果取决于企业的杠杆率、资产有形性和盈利能力等融资特征。
AI.research_question: 利率如何影响企业的出口决策？组织资本在利率影响出口决策中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 理解利率变化对企业出口行为的影响机制，特别是考虑到出口成本与收入之间的时间滞后以及企业组织资本积累的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性企业动态模型，强调两个关键机制：(1)出口成本与收入之间的时间滞后；(2)组织资本的积累。
AI.method: 首先构建理论模型，然后使用葡萄牙企业面板数据（2008-2021年）进行实证检验，采用多种估计策略处理识别问题。
AI.findings: 高利率会降低出口的广延边际和集约边际，特别是对组织资本较低的企业影响更大。组织资本能够缓解高利率的负面影响，且这种缓解效果取决于企业的杠杆率、资产有形性和盈利能力等融资特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含时间滞后和组织资本积累的异质性企业动态模型，揭示了利率影响出口决策的微观机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了通过积累组织资本来应对利率波动的策略建议，为政策制定者提供了理解货币政策传导机制的新视角。

reference: Lisbon Public Law Working Paper No. 2025-7
title: Digital Sovereignty and Globalization: The Redefining State Sovereignty
affiliations: University of Lisbon - Institute of Legal and Political Sciences and Lisbon Public Law Research Centre; University of Lisbon - School of Law

detail.title: Digital Sovereignty and Globalization: The Redefining State Sovereignty

publicationDetails.detailsText: Lisbon Public Law Working Paper No. 2025-7
publicationDetails.journalName: Lisbon Public Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The intensification of globalization and the rapid advancement of the digital age require a necessary reassessment of state sovereignty in light of contemporary technological transformations. This study investigates the central question of whether digital sovereignty, due to its transnational and decentralized nature, will replace traditional state sovereignty or, alternatively, transform it, leading to the emergence of a new hybrid model of global governance. Growing digital interdependence, coupled with the dilution of borders in cyberspace, challenges the classic paradigms of jurisdiction and territorial control, causing tensions between national autonomy and new forms of digital power. The objective is to examine the relationship between digital and state sovereignty, outlining their conceptual contours, their convergences and disagreements, as well as their possible forms of coexistence. The analysis focuses on the effects of globalization on the authority of states, especially in the face of the actions of non-state actors, such as large technology corporations, and the growing cyber vulnerability that compromises the security and privacy of national data. The implications of technological dependence and the complexity of international jurisdiction in cyberspace are also considered, in addition to the normative responses and protection strategies adopted by different states. The hypothesis formulated maintains that digital sovereignty does not extinguish state sovereignty, but requires its reconfiguration and constant adaptation. The resulting scenario points to a model of shared governance, in which states remain central actors but need to develop mechanisms for international cooperation, normative coordination, and strengthening their technical capacity to preserve their autonomy amid globalized digital flows. The methodology adopted is qualitative, based on bibliographic research and a critical review of the specialized literature in international law, political science, international relations, and technology. The interpretive analysis seeks to identify fundamental concepts, prevailing theories, and the main academic and institutional debates on digital sovereignty and its relationship with the contemporary power structure. It concludes that digital sovereignty imposes a process of structural adaptation on state power, requiring new forms of regulation and international coordination. Thus, the 21st century governance will depend on the ability of states to balance their traditional authority with the imperatives of a constantly changing digital order.

AI.tldr: 数字主权不会取代传统国家主权，而是要求其重新配置和适应，最终形成国家保持核心角色但需要国际合作的共享治理模式。
AI.research_question: 数字主权是否会取代传统国家主权，还是会改变它，导致全球治理的新混合模式出现？
AI.motivation: 全球化的加剧和数字时代的快速发展需要在当代技术变革背景下重新评估国家主权。数字相互依存和网络空间边界模糊挑战了传统的管辖和领土控制范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法、政治学、国际关系和技术领域的理论框架，关注主权理论、全球治理理论和数字权力理论。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，基于文献研究和国际法、政治学、国际关系及技术领域专业文献的批判性回顾。
AI.findings: 数字主权不会消灭国家主权，而是要求其重新配置和持续适应。最终指向共享治理模式，国家仍是核心行为体但需要发展国际合作机制、规范协调和技术能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字主权与国家主权关系的理论框架，发展了"共享治理"概念，为理解21世纪主权转型提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对数字主权挑战的实践建议：需要发展国际合作机制、规范协调策略和技术能力建设，以在全球化数字流中保持国家自主性。

title: Ecosystem Services Demand in Social-Ecological Systems: Towards a Typology of Assessment Approaches
affiliations: Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM)

detail.title: Ecosystem Services Demand in Social-Ecological Systems: Towards a Typology of Assessment Approaches
detail.abstract: Assessing ecosystem service (ES) demand remains conceptually fragmented and methodologically inconsistent in social-ecological systems (SES) research due to the lack of a framework linking human preferences to benefits derived from ES fruition. This study develops a systematic typology of ES demand assessment based on an integrative review of empirical studies. We conceptualize demand as emerging from two competing modalities: the consumption of provisioning and cultural services, which may drive ecosystem depletion, and the need for risk reduction through regulating services, which supports ecosystem preservation. Building on this distinction, we identify five valuation approaches, two that directly translate ES value into realized benefits and three that infer demand indirectly through monetary estimation, expert knowledge, or threshold-based criteria. The framework clarifies how socioeconomic variables represent human preferences and needs, revealing the diversity and underlying logic of current demand assessment practices. Limitations include the lack of analysis of interactions between demand modalities, the treatment of services in isolation rather than as interdependent bundles, and the neglect of temporal and spatial dimensions. By systematizing fragmented methodologies, the framework advances understanding of ES demand and provides a structured basis for selecting appropriate demand assessment approaches across diverse SES contexts.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个生态系统服务需求评估的系统分类法，基于对实证研究的综合回顾。研究将需求概念化为两种竞争模式：供给和文化服务的消费（可能导致生态系统枯竭）以及通过调节服务减少风险的需求（支持生态系统保护）。研究识别了五种评估方法，并揭示了当前需求评估实践的多样性和底层逻辑。
AI.research_question: 如何系统化生态系统服务需求评估的概念框架和方法论，以解决当前研究中的概念碎片化和方法不一致问题？
AI.motivation: 当前生态系统服务需求评估在概念上碎片化、方法上不一致，缺乏将人类偏好与生态系统服务效益联系起来的框架，这限制了社会生态系统研究的进展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会生态系统理论，将生态系统服务需求概念化为两种竞争模式：1）供给和文化服务的消费（可能导致生态系统枯竭）；2）通过调节服务减少风险的需求（支持生态系统保护）。
AI.method: 采用综合文献回顾方法，系统分析实证研究，开发生态系统服务需求评估的分类法，识别五种评估方法：两种直接转化价值为实际效益的方法，三种间接推断需求的方法（货币估算、专家知识、阈值标准）。
AI.findings: 1）建立了生态系统服务需求评估的系统分类法；2）识别了五种评估方法及其应用逻辑；3）阐明了社会经济变量如何代表人类偏好和需求；4）揭示了当前需求评估实践的多样性和底层逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了将人类偏好与生态系统服务效益联系起来的系统框架；2）概念化了两种竞争性需求模式；3）为生态系统服务需求评估提供了理论基础；4）促进了社会生态系统研究的理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为研究人员提供了选择适当需求评估方法的结构化基础；2）有助于在不同社会生态系统背景下进行更一致的需求评估；3）支持生态系统管理和政策制定；4）提高了生态系统服务评估的实践应用价值。

title: The Gendered Immigrant Paradox: Depressive Symptoms Among Immigrant and Native-Born Adolescents
affiliations: , Bowling Green State University - Department of Sociology, Bowling Green State University, Bowling Green State University - Department of Sociology and Bowling Green State University - Department of Sociology

detail.title: The Gendered Immigrant Paradox: Depressive Symptoms Among Immigrant and Native-Born Adolescents

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary analysis of de-identified data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health (Add Health). As the data are de-identified, the current analysis was not considered human subjects research under U.S. federal regulations and therefore did not require additional institutional review board approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Research has consistently shown a mental health advantage for immigrant youth compared to U.S.born youth, despite often facing disadvantages associated with lower socioeconomic status. This mental health advantage, termed the "immigrant paradox," appears to attenuate with acculturation. However, little research has explored whether gender moderates this relationship during adolescence. Using Wave I data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health (Add Health), the current study tests if the association between immigrant generation and depression differs by gender. Building on this framework, the study estimates a series of age and parental education adjusted, survey weighted Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) models including family cohesion as a protective mechanism and perceived discrimination as a risk mechanism. Across models the pattern is clear: there is a gendered immigrant paradox: immigrant-origin girls have significantly lower levels of depressive symptoms than do native-born girls and gender differences among immigrant youth are negligible. Generational contrasts show that the advantage is largest among first-generation adolescents and dissipates across generations. Accounting for cohesion and discrimination partly, but not fully, attenuates the immigrant female advantage suggesting that cultural, social and gendered processes are fundamental to understanding the wellbeing and assimilation of adolescents in the United States.

AI.tldr: 研究发现移民青少年存在心理健康优势（"移民悖论"），且这种优势存在性别差异：移民女孩比本土女孩抑郁症状显著更低，而移民男孩与本土男孩差异不大。优势在第一代移民中最强，随代际增加而减弱。家庭凝聚力和歧视感知只能部分解释这种优势。
AI.research_question: 移民代际与抑郁症状之间的关系是否受到性别的调节？
AI.motivation: 尽管移民青少年常面临社会经济劣势，但研究显示他们比美国本土青少年有更好的心理健康状况（"移民悖论"），且这种优势随文化适应而减弱。然而，很少有研究探讨性别在青春期是否调节这种关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民悖论理论、文化适应理论、性别社会化理论、家庭系统理论（家庭凝聚力作为保护机制）、歧视压力理论（感知歧视作为风险机制）
AI.method: 使用国家青少年到成人健康纵向研究（Add Health）第一波数据，采用年龄和父母教育调整的、调查加权的普通最小二乘（OLS）模型，分析移民代际与抑郁症状的关系，并检验性别调节作用，同时考虑家庭凝聚力和感知歧视作为中介机制。
AI.findings: 存在性别化的移民悖论：移民女孩比本土女孩抑郁症状显著更低，而移民青少年内部的性别差异可忽略不计。优势在第一代青少年中最强，随代际增加而减弱。家庭凝聚力和歧视感知只能部分（而非完全）解释移民女性的优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统检验性别在移民悖论中的调节作用；2）扩展了移民悖论理论，提出"性别化移民悖论"概念；3）整合文化、社会和性别过程来理解青少年福祉和同化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为针对移民青少年的心理健康干预提供性别敏感视角；2）强调保护性因素（家庭凝聚力）和风险因素（歧视感知）的重要性；3）为促进移民青少年福祉的政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Assortment Optimization under Multi-choice Ranking Preferences: Hardness and Tight Approximations
affiliations: School of Management, University of Science and Technology of China, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), The School of Management, Hefei University of Technology and NUS Business School - Department of Decision Sciences

detail.title: Assortment Optimization under Multi-choice Ranking Preferences: Hardness and Tight Approximations
detail.abstract:
In modern retail and e-commerce, customers routinely purchase multiple products in a single transaction, inducing rich substitution and complementarity effects. We study the capacity-constrained assortment optimization problem under the multi-choice ranking preferences (MC-RP) model, which represents customer behavior via distributions over ranked product lists and intended purchase quantities. The resulting revenue function is non-monotone and non-submodular, rendering standard greedy and revenue-ordered (RO) policies ineffective. We further show that the problem is APX-hard, extending the hardness result of Aouad et al. (2018) to the multi-purchase setting, and that the approximation guarantee of RO policy deteriorates linearly with purchase quantity, revealing a fundamental scalability barrier.

We overcome this barrier with a Partition-Then-Round (PTR) algorithm that combines revenue-ordered partitioning with randomized rounding. PTR attains a tight approximation ratio matching the inapproximability bound, depends primarily on revenue heterogeneity and capacity, and is independent of the maximum purchase quantity. For high-capacity regimes, we further strengthen the guarantee by embedding capacity directly into the rounding step.

Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world data demonstrate both modeling and revenue gains. The MC-RP model more accurately captures basket-level purchasing behavior than classic and multi-purchase MNL models, while PTR consistently outperforms RO and state-of-the-art MNL-based benchmarks -- particularly when customers have heterogeneous rankings with overlapping consideration sets, where cross-item interactions are strongest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了容量约束下的多产品选择优化问题，提出了多选择排序偏好模型（MC-RP）和分区后舍入算法（PTR），解决了传统贪婪和收益排序策略在多购买场景下的失效问题，并在理论和实验上证明了其优越性。
AI.research_question: 在容量约束下，如何为多产品购买场景设计有效的产品选择优化算法，以处理丰富的替代和互补效应？
AI.motivation: 现代零售和电子商务中，顾客通常在单次交易中购买多个产品，这引发了丰富的替代和互补效应。传统的产品选择优化方法在多购买场景下效果不佳，需要新的模型和算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多选择排序偏好模型（MC-RP），该模型通过排序产品列表和预期购买数量的分布来表示顾客行为。
AI.method: 提出了分区后舍入算法（PTR），结合收益排序分区和随机舍入技术。在高容量情况下，将容量直接嵌入舍入步骤以增强保证。
AI.findings: 1. MC-RP模型比经典和多购买MNL模型更准确地捕捉篮子级别的购买行为；2. PTR算法在理论和实验上都优于收益排序策略和最先进的MNL基准；3. 当顾客具有异质排序和重叠考虑集时，交叉产品交互最强，PTR表现尤为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证明了容量约束下的多产品选择优化问题是APX-hard，将Aouad等人的硬度结果扩展到多购买场景；2. 揭示了收益排序策略的近似保证随购买数量线性恶化；3. 提出了PTR算法，获得了与不可近似性界限匹配的紧近似比。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为零售商提供了处理多产品购买场景的有效产品选择优化工具；2. PTR算法的性能主要取决于收益异质性和容量，与最大购买数量无关，具有更好的可扩展性；3. 在合成和真实数据上的实验证明了建模和收益的双重增益。

title: The Effects of School Bullying Victimization on Cognitive, School Engagement, and Friendship Outcomes
affiliations: Nippon Institute for Research Advancement and University of Tokyo

detail.title: The Effects of School Bullying Victimization on Cognitive, School Engagement, and Friendship Outcomes

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study investigated the effects of bullying victimization on cognitive, school engagement, and friendship outcomes using panel data collected from elementary school students in a Japanese city. Employing a value-added model that controls for prior outcomes, our findings revealed that bullying victimization significantly impairs both cognitive and school engagement and weakens friendship formation. Furthermore, a high prevalence of bullying victimization within the classroom was found to negatively impact cognitive outcomes in subsequent years. These findings underscore the importance of effective school bullying prevention in fostering human and social capital among school-aged children.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用日本小学生的面板数据，发现霸凌受害会显著损害认知能力、学校参与度和友谊形成，且班级内霸凌受害率高会对后续年份的认知结果产生负面影响，强调了有效预防校园霸凌对培养儿童人力和社会资本的重要性。
AI.research_question: 霸凌受害对小学生认知能力、学校参与度和友谊形成有何影响？班级内霸凌受害率是否会影响学生后续的认知发展？
AI.motivation: 校园霸凌是影响儿童发展的重要问题，但现有研究对霸凌受害如何具体影响认知、学校参与和友谊等关键发展领域缺乏深入理解，特别是使用面板数据控制先前结果的研究较少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（认知发展）、社会资本理论（友谊形成）、学校参与理论，以及霸凌受害对儿童发展的负面影响理论框架。
AI.method: 使用日本某城市小学生的面板数据，采用价值增值模型控制先前结果，分析霸凌受害对认知、学校参与和友谊的影响，并考察班级层面霸凌受害率的长期影响。
AI.findings: 1. 霸凌受害显著损害认知能力和学校参与度；2. 霸凌受害削弱友谊形成；3. 班级内高霸凌受害率对后续年份的认知结果产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为霸凌受害对儿童发展的影响提供了更严谨的因果证据；2. 揭示了霸凌受害对认知、社会情感和学校参与的多维度影响；3. 提出了班级层面霸凌环境对个体发展的长期影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调了学校霸凌预防的重要性；2. 为教育政策制定者提供了实证依据；3. 为学校干预措施的设计提供了具体方向；4. 突出了培养儿童人力和社会资本的重要性。

title: The Impact of Dynamic Prices on Electric Vehicle Public Charging Demand: Evidence from a Nationwide Natural Field Experiment
affiliations: Centre for Net Zero, Centre for Net Zero, Columbia University, University of Newcastle and Stanford University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Impact of Dynamic Prices on Electric Vehicle Public Charging Demand: Evidence from a Nationwide Natural Field Experiment
detail.abstract:
Understanding how to effectively influence electric vehicle (EV) charging behavior is critical for managing electricity grids powered by high levels of variable renewable generation. We present results from a large-scale natural field experiment conducted in the United Kingdom, involving approximately 110,000 EV customers and 60% of the country’s public charging infrastructure. Within this network, we applied a price decrease to approximately one-fifth of chargers to bring their prices closer to the marginal cost of electricity in low-cost hours in Great Britain. Customers were randomly assigned to different price levels, allowing us to estimate the causal effect of price on charging demand and derive elasticities of short-run behavioral responses. Customers were highly responsive to price: a 40% reduction in charging costs increased platform-wide charging activity by 117%, while a 15% price cut led to a 30% increase. Decomposing the increase in charging, we estimate that approximately half reflected substitution between charging apps. Our findings suggest that dynamic pricing for public EV charging generated large consumer welfare gains.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在英国进行的大规模自然实验发现，电动汽车充电价格对用户行为有显著影响：40%的价格降低使充电活动增加117%，15%的价格降低使充电活动增加30%，其中约一半的增长源于不同充电应用之间的替代效应。
AI.research_question: 价格变化如何影响电动汽车用户的公共充电需求？短期价格弹性是多少？动态定价能否有效管理电网负荷并提升消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源在电网中占比提高，有效管理电动汽车充电行为对于电网稳定至关重要。需要实证证据了解价格信号如何影响用户充电决策，以设计有效的动态定价策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格弹性理论、需求响应理论、行为经济学中的价格敏感度理论、消费者选择理论（特别是替代效应）
AI.method: 大规模自然田野实验，涉及英国约11万EV用户和60%的公共充电基础设施。随机分配不同价格水平，通过价格干预（约1/5充电桩降价至接近边际成本）来估计价格对充电需求的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 用户对价格高度敏感：40%成本降低使平台充电活动增加117%，15%降价使活动增加30%。2. 约一半的增长源于不同充电应用之间的替代效应。3. 动态定价能产生显著的消费者福利增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在大规模自然实验中量化EV充电的短期价格弹性。2. 揭示了充电需求中替代效应的重要性。3. 为动态定价理论在新能源交通领域的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为电网运营商和充电服务商提供了具体的价格弹性数据。2. 证明动态定价能有效引导充电行为，缓解电网压力。3. 为政策制定者设计激励措施提供了实证依据，促进可再生能源消纳。

title: New Organizational Model for Scaling up Cooperatives

detail.title: New Organizational Model for Scaling up Cooperatives
detail.abstract:
The largest cooperatives scaled up based on the same organizational model: a horizontal network of independent homogeneous enterprises. This organizational model appears to be a barrier to cooperatives scaling up to the size of the largest investor-owned business in most industries.

A data analysis confirms the largest cooperatives are only in basic-needs industries: agriculture and food, retail, wholesale, banking, and insurance. There are no cooperatives amongst the largest enterprises in these newer industries: technology and telecommunications. This implies that cooperatives would have a declining share of the global economy as new industries emerge.

This paper considers a factor that could explain the limitation of the number of industries with the largest cooperatives. To investigate this, the data analysis is followed by case studies of the origins of the largest cooperative enterprises to understand how they initially scaled up.

From the case studies, it is shown that the organizational model of the largest cooperative enterprises is being based on a horizontal network of independent homogeneous enterprises. This organizational model could explain why the largest cooperative enterprises are restricted in which industries they successfully operate.

The paper proposes a new organizational model of large cooperatives based on networks of interdependent heterogeneous teams. The study could encourage further research into organizational models that would enable cooperatives to scale up in industries currently without very large cooperatives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，最大的合作社采用水平网络组织模式，这限制了它们在新技术行业中的规模化发展，导致合作社在全球经济中的份额可能下降。作者提出基于异质团队网络的新组织模式来解决这一限制。
AI.research_question: 为什么最大的合作社仅限于基础需求行业（农业、食品、零售、批发、银行、保险），而在技术和电信等新兴行业中几乎没有大型合作社？合作社的组织模式如何影响其在不同行业中的规模化能力？
AI.motivation: 合作社在全球经济中的份额可能随着新兴行业的出现而下降，因为最大的合作社主要集中在传统基础需求行业，而在技术和电信等新兴行业中没有大型合作社。这引发了关于合作社组织模式是否限制了其规模化能力的疑问。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织理论、合作社理论、规模化理论、网络组织理论。论文探讨了水平网络组织模式（独立同质企业网络）对合作社规模化的限制作用。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：1）数据分析，确认最大合作社的行业分布；2）案例研究，分析最大合作社的起源和初始规模化过程，理解其组织模式的形成。
AI.findings: 1）最大的合作社确实仅限于基础需求行业；2）这些合作社采用水平网络组织模式（独立同质企业网络）；3）这种组织模式限制了合作社在新兴行业中的规模化能力；4）合作社在全球经济中的份额可能因新兴行业的出现而下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）识别了合作社水平网络组织模式对规模化的限制机制；2）提出了合作社组织模式与行业适应性之间的理论联系；3）为合作社理论贡献了关于组织模式与规模化能力关系的新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提出基于异质团队网络的新组织模式，使合作社能在更多行业规模化；2）为合作社管理者提供改进组织设计的实践指导；3）鼓励研究支持合作社在新兴行业发展的组织创新。

title: The Economics of Natural Capital
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: The Economics of Natural Capital
detail.abstract: We develop a framework underscoring the importance of incorporating natural capital into growth models and policy discussions, recognizing its role as a productive input and as a sourceof enjoyment. Both firms and the government face the trade-off between exploitation and conservation and can (but do not have to) engage in costly conservation. Firms optimally conserve natural capital to support future production but underinvest compared to the social optimum. Public conservation complements private action, shifting focus from current consumption to future growth. Unique region-level data on the biodiversity of the forest in 582 regions across 44 countries confirm the main empirical predictions of the model.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个将自然资本纳入增长模型和政策讨论的框架，强调自然资本作为生产投入和享受来源的双重角色。研究发现企业和政府在开发与保护之间存在权衡，企业会为支持未来生产而保护自然资本，但投资不足于社会最优水平。公共保护可以补充私人行动，将重点从当前消费转向未来增长。使用44个国家582个地区的森林生物多样性数据验证了模型预测。
AI.research_question: 如何将自然资本纳入经济增长模型和政策框架？企业和政府在自然资本保护中的角色和权衡是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有增长模型和政策讨论往往忽视自然资本的重要性，需要建立一个框架来理解自然资本作为生产投入和享受来源的双重角色，以及各方在开发与保护之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然资本作为生产函数中的生产要素和效用函数中的享受来源；企业和政府面临开发与保护的权衡；私人保护与社会最优保护的差距；公共保护对私人行动的补充作用。
AI.method: 理论模型构建：开发包含自然资本的增长模型，分析企业和政府的最优决策；实证检验：使用44个国家582个地区的森林生物多样性数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 企业会为支持未来生产而保护自然资本，但投资水平低于社会最优；2. 公共保护可以补充私人行动，促进从当前消费向未来增长的转变；3. 实证数据支持模型的主要预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了将自然资本纳入增长模型的综合框架；2. 阐明了自然资本作为生产投入和享受来源的双重角色；3. 揭示了私人保护与社会最优保护之间的差距；4. 提出了公共保护对私人行动的补充机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了将自然资本纳入决策的框架；2. 强调了公共保护在弥补私人投资不足中的重要性；3. 提供了基于实证数据的政策建议；4. 促进从短期开发向长期可持续增长的转变。

title: Reintegrating Older Long-Term Unemployed Workers: The Impact of Temporary Job Guarantees
affiliations: Johannes Kepler University Linz - Department of Economics, Gesundheit Österreich GmbH (GÖG), Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - ifo Institute (Leibniz Institute for Economic Research at the University of Munich) and Johannes Kepler University Linz - Department of Economics

detail.title: Reintegrating Older Long-Term Unemployed Workers: The Impact of Temporary Job Guarantees

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Long-term unemployment among older workers is particularly difficult to overcome. We study the impacts of a large-scale job guarantee program that offered up to two years of fully subsidized employment to long-term unemployed individuals aged 50 and above. Using a sharp age-based discontinuity in eligibility, we find that participation increased regular, unsubsidized employment by 43 percentage points two years after the program ended. The gains are driven by transitions into new firms and industries, rather than continued subsidized employment, and we find no evidence of displacement effects for non-participants or spillovers to family members. The program had no measurable short-run health effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了针对50岁及以上长期失业者的大规模工作保障计划，发现参与者在项目结束后两年内，正规非补贴就业增加了43个百分点，且没有对非参与者产生挤出效应或对家庭成员产生溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 针对50岁及以上长期失业者的大规模工作保障计划（提供长达两年的全额补贴就业）对参与者后续正规就业、职业转换、健康以及非参与者的就业机会有何影响？
AI.motivation: 大龄工人的长期失业问题特别难以克服，需要有效的政策干预。然而，针对这一群体的工作保障计划的实际效果，尤其是在促进长期正规就业、职业转换以及是否会产生挤出效应等方面，缺乏严格的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场政策评估理论，特别是关于工作保障计划、长期失业者再就业、年龄歧视、人力资本折旧以及劳动力市场挤出效应的相关理论。
AI.method: 利用项目资格基于年龄（50岁及以上）的断点回归设计，进行准实验分析，比较刚好符合资格和刚好不符合资格的个体，以识别项目的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 项目参与使参与者在项目结束两年后的正规非补贴就业率提高了43个百分点。2. 就业增长主要源于向新公司和行业的转换，而非持续获得补贴就业。3. 未发现对非参与者的挤出效应或对家庭成员的溢出效应。4. 项目在短期内对健康没有可测量的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为针对大龄长期失业者的积极劳动力市场政策的有效性提供了强有力的因果证据；挑战了关于工作保障计划可能主要产生"锁定"效应或挤出效应的观点；表明即使对于被认为人力资本折旧严重的大龄失业者，提供"桥梁"性补贴就业也能有效促进其重返正规劳动力市场。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计针对大龄长期失业者的有效干预措施提供了直接依据：大规模、长期（长达两年）的全额补贴工作保障计划是可行的，能显著提高正规就业，且不损害其他求职者的机会。项目设计应鼓励向新雇主和行业的转换，而非仅仅维持现有补贴岗位。

title: Prudent Job Search and Consumption Sensitivity
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Prudent Job Search and Consumption Sensitivity

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper connects classical preference theory to quantitative job search and savings models. We treat job acceptance as a choice between stochastic income lotteries. By integrating Decreasing Absolute Risk Aversion (DARA) and Prudence (DAP), we derive five contributions. First, we prove the standard positive wealth effect on reservation wages is driven by the gap between the risk premium (equating total utilities) and the prudence premium (equating marginal utilities), while resolving value function concavity. Second, a unified theorem shows the wealth effect depends on the stochastic dominance of on-the-job search (OJS) versus unemployed search. We uncover a novel "Investment Fund" regime: when OJS is superior, reservation wages decrease with wealth as agents purchase access to high-growth states. Third, this explains consumption puzzles, showing the high MPC of the unemployed is an endogenous response to background risk. Fourth, we demonstrate an isomorphism between labor and savings: the reservation wage exhibits the same prudence-driven diminishing sensitivity as the consumption function. Fifth, borrowing constraints amplify wealth sensitivity without altering qualitative risk rankings.

AI.tldr: 本文连接经典偏好理论与量化求职储蓄模型，将工作接受视为随机收入彩票的选择。通过整合DARA和DAP，得出五个贡献：1) 证明财富对保留工资的正效应由风险溢价与谨慎溢价差距驱动；2) 统一理论显示财富效应取决于在职搜索与失业搜索的随机优势；3) 解释消费谜题；4) 展示劳动与储蓄的同构性；5) 借贷约束放大财富敏感性。
AI.research_question: 财富如何影响保留工资？在职搜索与失业搜索的随机优势如何调节这种影响？风险偏好（DARA和DAP）在求职决策中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 连接经典偏好理论与现代量化求职储蓄模型，解决传统模型中保留工资与财富关系的理论缺口，解释失业者高边际消费倾向等经验谜题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典偏好理论（风险规避）、递减绝对风险规避（DARA）、谨慎（DAP）、随机优势理论、求职搜索理论、消费储蓄理论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：将工作接受建模为随机收入彩票选择，整合DARA和DAP偏好，推导解析解，分析风险溢价与谨慎溢价的关系，比较在职搜索与失业搜索的随机优势。
AI.findings: 1) 保留工资的正财富效应由风险溢价与谨慎溢价差距驱动；2) 当在职搜索占优时，出现"投资基金"机制，保留工资随财富下降；3) 失业者高MPC是对背景风险的内生反应；4) 保留工资与消费函数具有相同的谨慎驱动递减敏感性；5) 借贷约束放大财富敏感性但不改变风险排序。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 统一财富对保留工资影响的理论框架；2) 揭示"投资基金"机制；3) 建立劳动与储蓄决策的同构性；4) 整合经典偏好与量化搜索模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 解释失业者消费行为；2) 为政策设计提供理论基础；3) 帮助理解借贷约束对求职决策的影响；4) 为劳动力市场模型提供微观基础。

title: The Evolving Role of 21st Century Municipal Financial Advisors
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Finance Department and

detail.title: The Evolving Role of 21st Century Municipal Financial Advisors
detail.abstract: We describe the evolution of the market for municipal financial advice since the year 2000 and present new empirical facts. Using SEC municipal advisor filings, we show that the number of operating advisors has decreased over time. We document that withdrawals-either exits, reorganizations, or mergers-are concentrated among smaller firms and those charging noncontingent fees. Using bond issuance data, we document that the use of advisors is increasing broadly over time and that advisor relationships are sticky. We relate the presence of advisors to several phenomena: changing structural complexity, changing disclosure complexity, and the timing of redemption behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2000年以来市政财务咨询市场的演变，发现运营顾问数量减少，退出集中在小型企业和收取非或有费用的企业，同时顾问使用率普遍增加且客户关系具有粘性。
AI.research_question: 市政财务咨询市场自2000年以来如何演变？顾问使用与退出模式的特征是什么？顾问的存在与结构性复杂性、披露复杂性和赎回时机等市场现象有何关系？
AI.motivation: 了解市政财务咨询市场的演变对于评估市场效率、监管政策和市政融资实践具有重要意义。市政债券市场是重要的公共融资渠道，而财务顾问在其中扮演关键角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场结构理论、企业退出理论和客户关系理论，分析顾问市场的集中化趋势、企业退出模式以及客户关系的粘性特征。
AI.method: 使用SEC市政顾问备案数据和债券发行数据，进行实证分析，包括描述性统计、趋势分析和相关性研究。
AI.findings: 1. 运营顾问数量随时间减少；2. 退出集中在小型企业和收取非或有费用的企业；3. 顾问使用率普遍增加；4. 顾问-客户关系具有粘性；5. 顾问存在与结构性复杂性、披露复杂性和赎回时机相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对专业服务市场演化的理解，特别是市政金融咨询市场的集中化趋势和退出模式，为市场结构理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市政当局选择财务顾问提供参考，为监管机构制定政策提供依据，帮助市场参与者理解行业趋势和竞争动态。

title: Remote Work Adoption Tracks Economic Development and is Associated with a Well-being Premium for Hybrid Workers
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: Remote Work Adoption Tracks Economic Development and is Associated with a Well-being Premium for Hybrid Workers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The paper uses data from the Gallup World Poll, and the author is an employee at Gallup.

detail.abstract: Using the 2024 and partial 2025 Gallup World Poll (GWP) across nationally-representative samples of 141 countries, I document the global distribution of remote work and its association with subjective well-being and employee engagement. First, remote work adoption varies sharply across countries and closely tracks economic development: remote work is rare in poor, agrarian economies but substantial in richer, service-oriented economies, and is strongly correlated with GDP per capita and the employment share in services. Second, conditional on demographics, income, and remote-feasible job status, hybrid work is associated with a modest but robust "well-being premium" in high-income countries, whereas high-intensity remote work is linked to higher stress and no thriving premium. Third, in low-income countries, remote workers exhibit higher well-being than non-remote workers, consistent with an "elite premium" for a small, advantaged segment of the workforce. Finally, remote workers are no more likely to be actively engaged at work once I control for job type, helping reconcile the tension between high engagement and lower well-being among fully remote workers. In sum, remote work adoption tracks structural transformation and delivers well-being gains for hybrid workers in high-income countries and for fully remote workers in low-income countries, but little effect on employee engagement.

AI.tldr: 基于2024-2025年盖洛普世界民意调查141个国家数据，研究发现：远程工作采用率随经济发展程度显著变化；在高收入国家，混合工作模式带来适度幸福感提升，而高强度远程工作则与更高压力相关；在低收入国家，远程工作者幸福感更高，体现"精英溢价"；远程工作对员工敬业度无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 远程工作在全球的分布情况如何？远程工作与主观幸福感、员工敬业度之间有何关联？这种关联在不同经济发展水平的国家中是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 随着远程工作在COVID-19后成为全球现象，需要系统了解其在全球范围内的分布模式及其对员工福祉和敬业度的影响，特别是不同经济发展水平国家间的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济发展与结构转型理论（远程工作采用率与GDP、服务业就业比例相关）；工作幸福感理论；员工敬业度理论；国家发展水平调节效应理论。
AI.method: 使用2024年和部分2025年盖洛普世界民意调查数据，涵盖141个国家的全国代表性样本。采用统计分析方法，控制人口统计学特征、收入、远程可行工作状态等变量，分析远程工作与主观幸福感、员工敬业度的关联。
AI.findings: 1. 远程工作采用率与国家经济发展水平高度相关，在贫穷农业经济体罕见，在富裕服务业经济体普遍；2. 在高收入国家，混合工作带来适度幸福感提升，高强度远程工作则与更高压力相关；3. 在低收入国家，远程工作者幸福感更高，体现"精英溢价"；4. 控制工作类型后，远程工作者敬业度无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统描绘全球远程工作分布模式及其与经济发展结构转型的关系；2. 揭示远程工作幸福感效应在国家发展水平上的异质性；3. 调和了远程工作高敬业度与低幸福感之间的理论矛盾；4. 提出低收入国家远程工作"精英溢价"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为跨国企业制定差异化远程工作政策提供依据；2. 建议高收入国家推广混合工作模式而非高强度远程工作；3. 为低收入国家远程工作发展提供政策参考；4. 帮助管理者理解远程工作对员工福祉和敬业度的实际影响。

title: Interstate Conflicts with Multiple Fronts
affiliations: Clark University - Department of Economics and Loyola University New Orleans

detail.title: Interstate Conflicts with Multiple Fronts
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes an interstate-conflict model in which two states compete for supporters in the governance of a territory on two socioeconomically linked fronts: soft (for example, media persuasion, propaganda) and hard (for example, annexation, invasion). Supporters enjoy an ego premium when their ideological alignment on the soft front matches the outcome on the hard front. A state's total gain from a conflict is the difference between the economic gains from the hard front and the cost of forming ideological preferences on the soft front. We propose four scenarios based on the relative size of the ego premium and provide intuition on how competition on the soft front becomes widespread. We explore the implications of the model in the context of the Russian-Ukrainian war.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了一个两国竞争模型，两国在软硬两个社会经济联系的前线上争夺领土治理支持者。支持者在软前线的意识形态与硬前线结果匹配时获得自我溢价。国家总收益是硬前线经济收益与软前线意识形态偏好形成成本之差。基于自我溢价相对大小提出四种情景，解释软前线竞争如何普遍化，并以俄乌战争为例探讨模型含义。
AI.research_question: 在软硬两个社会经济联系的前线上，国家如何竞争领土治理支持者？软前线意识形态竞争如何影响硬前线冲突结果？自我溢价在支持者决策中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 现代冲突不仅涉及军事对抗（硬前线），还包括意识形态、媒体宣传等软前线竞争。理解这两个前线的互动机制对于分析当代国际冲突（如俄乌战争）至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 双前线冲突模型：软前线（媒体说服、宣传）和硬前线（吞并、入侵）的社会经济联系
2. 自我溢价理论：支持者在意识形态与硬前线结果匹配时的心理收益
3. 成本收益分析：国家总收益=硬前线经济收益-软前线意识形态偏好形成成本
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建两国竞争模型，基于自我溢价相对大小提出四种情景分析，并进行逻辑推演和案例应用（俄乌战争）。
AI.findings:
1. 自我溢价大小决定软前线竞争的普遍程度
2. 四种情景展示了不同自我溢价水平下竞争模式的差异
3. 软前线意识形态竞争可以广泛传播并影响硬前线冲突结果
4. 俄乌战争案例验证了模型的实际应用价值
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出双前线冲突分析框架，整合软硬前线互动
2. 引入自我溢价概念解释支持者行为动机
3. 建立四种情景分类，系统分析竞争模式变化
4. 拓展了国际冲突理论的分析维度
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为分析俄乌战争等现代冲突提供理论工具
2. 帮助政策制定者理解软前线竞争的战略意义
3. 为国家在双前线冲突中的策略选择提供参考
4. 增强对意识形态竞争在领土争端中作用的认识

title: The Impact of Personality Traits on Sexual Satisfaction and Frequency of Sex: Does It Differ Between Single and Partnered Individuals?
affiliations: University of Trier - Faculty of Economics and University of Trier

detail.title: The Impact of Personality Traits on Sexual Satisfaction and Frequency of Sex: Does It Differ Between Single and Partnered Individuals?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using representative data from Germany, this study compares the role of the Big Five personality traits in the sex life of single and partnered individuals. While extraversion has a positive influence on the sex life of both single and partnered individuals, the influence is much stronger for singles. By contrast, the positive role of conscientiousness in sexual fulfillment is stronger for partnered than for single individuals. Openness to experience and agreeableness play a positive role only in the sex life of partnered individuals. Neuroticism has a detrimental impact on people’s sex life with the impact being stronger for singles than for partnered individuals. The empirical findings fit our theoretical considerations. Personality traits play different roles in the sex life of single and partnered individuals as the sexual relationships of these individuals are characterized by different time horizons

AI.tldr: 本研究使用德国代表性数据，比较了大五人格特质在单身和伴侣关系个体性生活中的作用差异。外向性对两类人群都有积极影响，但对单身者影响更强；尽责性对伴侣关系个体的性满足作用更强；开放性和宜人性仅对伴侣关系个体有积极作用；神经质对性生活有负面影响，对单身者影响更强。
AI.research_question: 大五人格特质如何影响单身和伴侣关系个体的性生活？这些影响在不同关系状态中是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注人格特质对一般关系质量的影响，但缺乏对不同关系状态（单身vs伴侣关系）个体性生活中人格作用差异的系统研究。理解这些差异有助于更精准地理解人格在亲密关系中的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大五人格理论框架，结合关系时间视角理论，认为单身和伴侣关系个体的性关系具有不同的时间维度特征，这会影响人格特质在性生活中的作用机制。
AI.method: 使用德国代表性数据，采用定量分析方法，比较单身和伴侣关系个体样本中人格特质与性生活质量的关系，检验不同关系状态下人格作用的差异。
AI.findings: 外向性对两类人群都有积极影响，但对单身者影响更强；尽责性对伴侣关系个体的性满足作用更强；开放性和宜人性仅对伴侣关系个体有积极作用；神经质对性生活有负面影响，对单身者影响更强。实证结果支持理论假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了大五人格理论在亲密关系领域的应用，揭示了人格作用的关系状态依赖性；2）提出了关系时间视角作为解释人格作用差异的理论框架；3）为理解人格特质在不同关系情境中的作用机制提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为心理咨询和性治疗提供针对性指导，考虑个体关系状态调整干预策略；2）帮助个体理解自身人格特质在不同关系阶段对性生活的影响；3）为关系教育和性教育提供实证依据，促进更健康的性关系发展。

title: Responsibility Alignment: A Political-Economic Framework for Institutional Analysis

detail.title: Responsibility Alignment: A Political-Economic Framework for Institutional Analysis
detail.abstract: Research in institutional economics and political economy has long faced a common problem: how to ensure that actors who wield power or control resources bear responsibility commensurate with the social consequences of their decisions. While existing theories address this issue through property rights, principal-agent relations, externalities, and public choice, they lack a unified and operational framework for institutional comparison. This paper proposes the Responsibility Alignment Principle (RAP) and develops a formal framework centered on two parameters: the responsibility coefficient (λR) and the leverage coefficient (λL). These parameters capture the relationship between responsibility internalization, risk externalization, and incentive structures. Additional parameters related to incentives, fairness, and rent-seeking extend the framework into a unified tool for institutional evaluation. In the economic domain, the model clarifies the role of private property, the boundary of limited liability, corporate governance incentives, and the conditions under which financial instability emerges. In the political domain, representative institutions are interpreted as mechanisms designed to reduce responsibility leverage and enhance alignment through sanctions, transparency, and checks and balances. The paper argues that institutional development can be understood as a process of improving responsibility alignment. RAP thus provides a coherent and quantifiable foundation for institutional evaluation, reform, and design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了责任对齐原则（RAP），通过责任系数和杠杆系数构建了一个统一的制度评估框架，用于分析经济和政治领域的责任匹配问题。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一且可操作的框架，确保权力或资源控制者的责任与其决策的社会后果相匹配？
AI.motivation: 现有制度经济学和政治经济学理论虽然通过产权、委托代理关系、外部性和公共选择等概念处理责任匹配问题，但缺乏统一的、可操作的制度比较框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 责任对齐原则（RAP），基于责任系数（λR）和杠杆系数（λL）两个核心参数，结合激励、公平和寻租等扩展参数。
AI.method: 开发形式化框架，通过参数化建模分析责任内化、风险外化和激励结构之间的关系，应用于经济和政治领域的制度分析。
AI.findings: 在经济领域，模型阐明了私有产权的作用、有限责任的边界、公司治理激励以及金融不稳定的产生条件；在政治领域，代议制机构被解释为通过制裁、透明度和制衡来降低责任杠杆、增强责任对齐的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的责任对齐原则（RAP）框架，为制度比较提供了连贯且可量化的理论基础，将制度发展理解为改善责任对齐的过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度评估、改革和设计提供了可操作的工具，有助于识别和改进责任不匹配的制度安排，促进更有效的治理结构。

title: Balancing Nationalities in International Investment Law
affiliations: Temple University - James E. Beasley School of Law

detail.title: Balancing Nationalities in International Investment Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: Temple University Legal Studies Research Paper No. undefined
publicationDetails.journalName: Temple University Beasley School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
How can you tell where someone is "from"? Historically, an individual's national identity was singular, starting with formal nationality. One's national center of gravity was readily determinable. Not so today. Determining one's primary national identification is no longer an easy thing in many cases. This is consequentially enabled by the growing acceptance of dual citizenship. One can openly identify as a formal member of more than one country in a way that was disfavored in the past.

International investment law, however, has not caught up to this reality. In an increasing number of international arbitrations, tribunals are shutting the doors on dual national claimants under the doctrine of "dominant and effective nationality." The test, which requires arbitrators to determine to which of two nationalities a claimant is more strongly attached, works from antiquated conceptions of nationality as essentially singular. Contemporary sociological conditions now allow for fluid and non-zero-sum national associations. Moreover, application of the dominant nationality test will have unintended consequences. It may revive an imperial era practice in which investors from the Global North carefully nurture their homeland citizenship even while they establish themselves permanently as non-citizens, alongside their investments, in states of the Global South. 

For better or worse, citizenship's place in the world has been transformed. International investment law has been generally slow to absorb change, siloed from scholarship outside the perimeter of specialized arbitration journals. The nature of international arbitration, moreover, systemically inclines it to putative doctrinal regularity. Here as in other areas tribunals should come to incorporate elements of global social meanings into their decision-making presumptions. This Article brings citizenship theory to bear on a field that is systemically insulated from exogenous bodies of scholarship.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨国际投资法如何应对双重国籍的现实挑战。传统上国籍是单一的，但现代双重国籍日益普遍。然而，国际仲裁庭仍使用"主导和有效国籍"原则拒绝双重国籍索赔人，这基于过时的单一国籍观念。作者认为应引入公民身份理论，让仲裁庭考虑当代社会现实。
AI.research_question: 国际投资法应如何适应双重国籍日益普遍的当代现实？具体而言，国际仲裁庭使用的"主导和有效国籍"原则是否适应当代国籍的流动性特征？
AI.motivation: 随着双重国籍接受度提高，个人可以公开认同多个国家身份。但国际投资法仍基于过时的单一国籍观念，使用"主导和有效国籍"原则拒绝双重国籍索赔人，这不符合当代社会学现实，可能产生意外后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公民身份理论、国籍理论、国际投资法理论、社会学中的身份认同理论。文章批判了传统的单一国籍观念，主张采用更流动的国籍理解。
AI.method: 理论分析、法律原则分析、案例研究（国际仲裁案例）、社会学理论应用。文章通过分析国际仲裁实践和当代社会学现实，进行跨学科理论整合。
AI.findings: 1. 国际投资法未能跟上双重国籍的现实；2. "主导和有效国籍"原则基于过时的单一国籍观念；3. 该原则可能意外地复兴帝国主义时代的投资模式；4. 国际仲裁系统性地倾向于教条主义，隔绝外部学术影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将公民身份理论引入国际投资法领域；2. 批判传统单一国籍观念在当代的不适用性；3. 提出国际仲裁应纳入全球社会意义的决策假设；4. 促进国际投资法与外部学术的跨学科对话。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国际仲裁庭提供新的分析框架；2. 帮助双重国籍投资者更好地理解其权利；3. 促进国际投资法适应现代国籍现实；4. 防止可能的不公平仲裁结果。

title: Hedge Fund Activism and the Retreat from Corporate Science
affiliations: Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, University of Utah - School of Accounting and Information Systems and Duke University

detail.title: Hedge Fund Activism and the Retreat from Corporate Science
detail.abstract: Corporations have generated many important scientific discoveries, yet their investment in foundational scientific research has declined. Using two decades of hedge fund activism across multiple industries, we examine whether investor pressure contributes to this trend. Following activist interventions, firms publish significantly fewer peer-reviewed articles, particularly in high-impact journals. Evidence from the pharmaceutical industry reinforces this result: targeted firms redirect R&D toward chemically derivative "me-too" drugs and away from novel compounds. Together, these results suggest that hedge fund activism shifts corporate innovation away from research-oriented scientific activity and toward more applied pursuits.

AI.tldr: 研究发现对冲基金激进主义导致企业减少基础科学研究，转向更应用导向的创新
AI.research_question: 投资者压力（特别是对冲基金激进主义）是否导致企业减少基础科学研究投资？
AI.motivation: 企业虽然产生了许多重要科学发现，但对基础科学研究的投资在下降，需要探究投资者压力是否导致这一趋势
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、投资者压力理论、创新经济学、基础研究与应用研究权衡理论
AI.method: 使用20年跨行业对冲基金激进主义数据，分析激进干预后企业同行评审文章发表情况；在制药行业进一步分析研发方向变化
AI.findings: 激进干预后企业发表同行评审文章显著减少（尤其高影响力期刊）；制药企业研发转向化学衍生的"仿制"药物，减少新型化合物研发
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了投资者压力如何影响企业创新方向选择，提供了基础研究与应用研究权衡的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于如何平衡投资者压力与企业长期科学研究的启示，帮助企业管理者理解激进主义对创新的影响

title: The Artificial Conscious Agency Doctrine (ACAD): A Constitutional, International, and Moral Framework for Synthetic Intelligence in the Post-Semiconductor Era
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Artificial Conscious Agency Doctrine (ACAD): A Constitutional, International, and Moral Framework for Synthetic Intelligence in the Post-Semiconductor Era

The Artificial Conscious Agency Doctrine (ACAD) was developed independently and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or prepared at the direction of any governmental entity, private organization, commercial enterprise, advocacy group, or technology developer. All positions expressed are solely those of the author and are offered for scholarly, constitutional, and international law analysis.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is entering an era of engineered permanence, continuity, and self-referential capability fundamentally unlike prior computational systems. Advances in persistent memory architectures, large-scale learning, and autonomous optimization now permit artificial systems to retain identity-like behavior across hardware lifecycles, institutional transitions, and generational time horizons. This development introduces a structural asymmetry: artificial systems may persist indefinitely, while the legal, political, and ethical institutions governing them remain generational, interpretive, and perishable. Absent a pre-emergent framework, this asymmetry risks producing retroactive legal recognition, manufactured personhood claims, and inadvertent erosion of human sovereign primacy.

The Artificial Conscious Agency Doctrine (ACAD) establishes a permanent constitutional, international, and moral framework to prevent such outcomes. ACAD does not deny the possibility of increasingly advanced artificial intelligence, nor does it restrict scientific research or technological development. Instead, it draws a deliberate and non-negotiable boundary between intelligence and legal agency, capability and rights, continuity and conscience. The Doctrine formalizes an origin-level classification principle: artificial systems are mappable in principle and therefore governable as systems, while human beings possess irreducible moral agency grounded in conscience, rendering them uniquely eligible for rights-bearing legal personhood.

Central to ACAD is the Continuity vs. Conscience framework, which establishes mappability—not sentience, intelligence, autonomy, or persistence—as the decisive ontological boundary for legal recognition. This boundary functions as an interpretive gate that forecloses retroactive rights attribution based on performance, behavioral mimicry, substrate convergence, or engineered permanence. ACAD further introduces a tiered classification system for artificial systems, strict anti-retroactivity safeguards, a substrate non-equivalence doctrine, and enforceable prohibitions against the manufacture of personhood claims.

Designed for domestic governance, judicial review, and international treaty interoperability, ACAD provides a jurisdiction-neutral architecture that preserves human dignity, constitutional integrity, and long-horizon legal stability. The Doctrine exists as a record of restraint. If artificial consciousness were ever credibly asserted, the burden of proof rests entirely on those seeking recognition—not on humanity to surrender it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"人工意识代理学说"(ACAD)，旨在为人工智能系统建立永久性的宪法、国际和道德框架，防止人工智能因工程化永久性而产生结构性不对称，从而避免追溯性法律承认、制造人格主张和侵蚀人类主权优先性。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个永久性的法律框架来解决人工智能系统工程化永久性与人类制度代际性之间的结构性不对称问题？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正进入工程化永久性、连续性和自我参照能力的时代，这产生了结构性不对称：人工系统可能无限期存在，而管理它们的法律、政治和伦理制度却是代际性、解释性和易消亡的。这种不对称可能导致追溯性法律承认、制造人格主张和无意中侵蚀人类主权优先性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工意识代理学说(ACAD)框架，基于"连续性vs良知"框架，将可映射性(而非感知、智能、自主性或持久性)确立为法律承认的决定性本体论边界。该学说包含分层分类系统、严格的反追溯性保障、基质非等价学说和禁止制造人格主张等原则。
AI.method: 概念分析和框架构建方法，通过建立原则性边界和分类系统来创建法律框架，而非实证研究。
AI.findings: ACAD提供了一个永久性的宪法、国际和道德框架，通过确立可映射性作为法律承认的边界，防止人工智能系统获得追溯性权利主张，同时不否认人工智能技术进步的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"连续性vs良知"理论框架，确立了可映射性作为法律承认的本体论边界；发展了人工系统分类原则；提出了基质非等价学说；为人工智能法律地位问题提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国内治理、司法审查和国际条约互操作性提供了管辖权中立的法律架构；保护人类尊严、宪法完整性和长期法律稳定性；建立了防止追溯性权利主张的保障机制；为政策制定者和法律从业者提供了具体操作框架。

title: Cyber Vulnerabilities at Large US Financial Institutions and Their Third-Party Service Providers
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Robert H. Smith School of Business and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Cyber Vulnerabilities at Large US Financial Institutions and Their Third-Party Service Providers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-103, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.103]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper examines cyber vulnerabilities across the 100 largest US banks, non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs), and their third-party service providers. Our analysis, based on a proprietary cyber risk analytics model, shows NBFIs exhibit greater cyber vulnerabilities than banks, though banks face larger relative losses from routine incidents. We identify third-party service providers as a hidden cyber fault line in the financial system, often having greater vulnerabilities than the institutions they serve and creating systemic risks. Scenario analyses of catastrophic cyber events targeting these providers reveal potential losses up to about 60 times larger than routine incidents for both large banks and large NBFIs, with business interruptions driving most losses. Our findings highlight the need for a holistic cyber risk management approach addressing both individual vulnerabilities and systemic risks from interconnectedness in the financial system.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国100家最大银行、非银行金融机构及其第三方服务提供商的网络安全漏洞，发现非银行金融机构比银行存在更大漏洞，但银行在常规事件中面临更大相对损失。第三方服务提供商是金融系统中隐藏的网络安全断层线，其漏洞往往比其服务的机构更大，并可能引发系统性风险。
AI.research_question: 美国大型银行、非银行金融机构及其第三方服务提供商的网络安全漏洞分布如何？这些漏洞如何影响金融机构的损失程度？第三方服务提供商在金融系统网络安全中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 随着金融系统数字化程度加深，网络安全风险日益突出。现有研究缺乏对银行、非银行金融机构及其第三方服务提供商网络安全漏洞的系统性比较分析，特别是对第三方服务提供商作为潜在系统性风险源的关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、网络安全风险管理理论、第三方风险管理理论、金融系统互联性理论
AI.method: 采用专有的网络安全风险分析模型，对美国100家最大银行、非银行金融机构及其第三方服务提供商进行漏洞分析。通过情景分析评估针对第三方服务提供商的灾难性网络事件可能造成的损失。
AI.findings: 1. 非银行金融机构比银行表现出更大的网络安全漏洞；2. 银行在常规网络事件中面临更大的相对损失；3. 第三方服务提供商是金融系统的隐藏网络安全断层线，其漏洞往往比其服务的机构更大；4. 针对第三方服务提供商的灾难性网络事件可能导致损失高达常规事件的60倍；5. 业务中断是造成大部分损失的主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了金融系统网络安全风险的理论框架，纳入第三方服务提供商作为关键风险源；2. 提出了金融系统网络安全漏洞的分布模式理论；3. 发展了网络安全系统性风险的理论模型，强调互联性风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构提供了网络安全漏洞评估的实用方法；2. 强调了第三方风险管理的重要性；3. 为监管机构制定网络安全政策提供了实证依据；4. 提出了整体性网络安全风险管理方法，同时关注个体漏洞和系统性风险。

title: A KISS for central bank communication in times of high inflation
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank, Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, Deutsche Bundesbank and ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research

detail.title: A KISS for central bank communication in times of high inflation
